gates: no label read before the committed registration and its verified public receipt (drf.common.registered)
'fit' reads need a committed, unchanged mechanism card under results/<campaign>/cards/ (path, SHA-256 and commit logged with the read)
MODEL_SELECT labels are never read by a fitting entry point (drf.dr)
CALIBRATION labels are not read by this campaign (no calibrate operation)
label reads run only inside a queue unit (DRF_UNIT_ID)
entry points can be added only by a dated, committed ACCESS_AMENDMENTS.json entry before first use
log: .private/<campaign>/access/LABEL_ACCESS.jsonl (append-only; utc, unit id, entry point, role, fields, operation, purpose, people, households, row-set hash, card)

benchmark.what: original-benchmark utility (24 clauses + 4 guards), the development reserve and paired utility costs of saved releases (logged adaptive evaluation; never a fitting input)

fit.what: fitting release parameters of the family, its continuation or a control on the full MODEL_FIT pool (household-grouped internal folds for any cross-fitting or calibration); SEX only as a training label of a protection objective or a within-SEX utility constraint named by the committed card, or as the evaluation label of a MODEL_FIT check

readers.what: fresh development reader grid (FIT / VALIDATION / SCORE reader roles inside MODEL_SELECT)

verify.what: independent verifier replay with separate metric, selection and reader code

source_artefacts: the inherited private trees of the working cache (finite-routing comparison, new-release-mechanisms, input-and-pair, dual-design, income- and occupation-headroom and the others) and the acs_replication tree are read-only inputs (SOURCE_ADMISSION.json); nothing is written under the source campaigns' paths
